newsitem.title: USA: Fed expected not to act during intervention time.
newsitem.headline: Fed expected not to act during intervention time.

text.p: The Federal Reserve likely will stay out of the money markets on Friday, but there is a slight chance it will add reserves via system repurchase agreements, analysts said.

Thursday the Fed added reserves to the banking system via four- and 13-day fixed system repurchase agreements and economists said they expected the Fed's add need to be about $14.5 billion during the second week of the current maintenance period.
Federal funds opened above target at 5-5/16 percent.
-- John P. Hughes, N.A. Treasury Desk, 212-859-1867
